remarks: Charming 1 bedroom, 1 bath apartment on Rowayton's Bell Island. FULLY FURNISHED, patio garden, use of 2 private beaches on Long Island Sound and 4 parks all within walking distance to the seaside village of Rowayton. Private rear entrance opens to large eat in kitchen with gas range, dishwasher and completely equipped pantry. Oversized living room with electric fireplace, tv, sitting nook and comfortable couches. Spacious bedroom with hug closet and book shelves. Spotlessly clean. Move in ready. Full size washer and dryer in unit. Ample closet space. New linens provided. Bi-monthly cleaning included in rent. Landlord pays annual association fee for access to beaches. Tenant pays for electricity, heat, cable, internet. Please NO PETS, NO SMOKING. FURNISHED. Easy 60 minutes to NYC on Metro North. A truly special place.
